subject.title: fix(voice-call): persist assistant transcript on call.speaking events

question: Should this PR keep the boot-run session/memory changes, or should it be narrowed to the voice-call transcript fix before further review?
rationale: The central voice-call bug is valid, but the branch also changes BOOT.md prompt handling, session classification, memory ingestion, and cleanup semantics; choosing whether to carry or split that security/session work is a maintainer boundary decision.

options.title: Narrow To Voice Fix

options.title: Split Boot Work
